lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Training example two. The telephonic enrollment confirmation call. All names, plans and numbers are fictional.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Kim, this is Isabel Fuentes, a licensed insurance agent, license number zero, G, one, two, three, four, five.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: Before we begin, this call is being recorded, and I am not affiliated with Medicare or the government. We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent six organizations which offer forty-two products in your area. Please contact Medicare dot gov or one eight hundred Medicare to get information on all of your options.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: We have your signed Scope of Appointment to discuss Medicare Advantage plans today. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: You've chosen to enroll in the Example Advantage plan from Example Health Plan. I'll now call their enrollment line to confirm your information and finalize your enrollment. Is it okay to proceed?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Isabel conferences in the carrier's enrollment line.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: Hello, I'm Isabel Fuentes, a licensed agent appointed with Example Health Plan. I have Robert Kim on the line. He has completed a plan review and is ready to enroll. This call is recorded, and I am not affiliated with Medicare or the government. His Scope of Appointment covers Medicare Advantage.

lines.speaker: Rep
lines.text: Thank you. Mr. Kim, please state your full name and date of birth.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Robert Kim. March third, nineteen fifty-nine.

lines.speaker: Rep
lines.text: Mr. Kim, you are completing an enrollment request into the Example Advantage plan, effective January first, twenty twenty-seven. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Rep
lines.text: Please read the Medicare number from your card.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Um, where is that?

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: It's the eleven-character Medicare Number printed on your card.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh, here it is. One, E, G, four. T, E, five. M, K, seven, three.

lines.speaker: Rep
lines.text: Thank you. Do you understand that you are enrolling, and do you agree?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: Rep
lines.text: Your confirmation number is E, X, four, eight, two, one, seven.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: Reading it back. E, X, four, eight, two, one, seven. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Isabel
lines.text: Congratulations, Mr. Kim. I'm writing your confirmation number on your application, your Scope of Appointment, and your receipt now. Example Health Plan will mail your enrollment materials and ID card, and your coverage starts January first. Call me at five five five, zero one four two with any questions.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Notice that Isabel pointed Mr. Kim to his card but never read the number for him, and read the confirmation number back before the call ended.
